Precinct 12 relocated from Fort Pierce Masonic Lodge to Days Inn Midtown at 3224 S. US Highway 1

material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: The precise precincts, former polling sites and replacement addresses establish the same event. Do not replace its polling instructions with the incoming article's conflicting assignments for precincts 67, 86 and 83 without verification.
